fact: BCEAO Instruction n°001-01-2024 on payment services came into force on 23 January 2024 in the WAEMU member states, covering banks, payment institutions and e-money institutions.
title: UEMOA : Entrée en vigueur de l'instruction n°001-01-2024 relative aux services de paiement dans les Etats membres de l'UMOA
